title: Price Protection Coverage Table for Pre-Orders & Back-Orders
content:
The Pricing desk keeps this coverage table for Pre-Orders & Back-Orders reservations. For each reservation type it shows whether the type carries price protection, which price the protection compares, and how a lower price is applied.

| | Standard Back-Order | Supplier Direct Back-Order | Seasonal Pre-Order | Launch Pre-Order | Deposit Pre-Order | Made-to-Order Reservation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Price protection | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| Price compared | Lowest regular price between reservation and shipment | Lowest regular price between reservation and shipment | Lowest regular price between reservation and shipment | Not applicable | Lowest regular price between reservation and shipment | Not applicable |
| How a lower price is applied | Lower unit price before shipment | Lower unit price before shipment | Lower unit price before shipment | Not applicable | Lower unit price before shipment | Not applicable |

**Coverage at a glance**

- Covered: Standard Back-Order, Supplier Direct Back-Order, Seasonal Pre-Order, Deposit Pre-Order.
- Not covered: Launch Pre-Order, Made-to-Order Reservation. Neither type has a compared price or an application method. Both are marked "not applicable".
- Where coverage applies, a lower price is applied to the reserved unit price before the item ships, never after.
